Bleak 3.0.2 is the optional-at-import native BLE transport dependency.
Upstream: https://github.com/hbldh/bleak
Documentation: https://bleak.readthedocs.io/en/latest/
PyPI wheel: bleak-3.0.2-py3-none-any.whl
SHA256: 39092feb9e83f1df5ad2f88e837723c7211c982ce9e9cda6235104bc2ebe0d0d
MIT license text from that wheel; line endings/terminal blank lines normalized. The backend uses Windows WinRT,
not BlackShark BluetoothComm.dll or a vendor helper. Existing PyWinRT notices
remain applicable to the required Windows backend projection packages.
No BlackShark binaries are included in RIO source or this module.
